C-RELEASE-LEDGER-GUARD.Name: Train-ledger membership guard — implementation plan
C-RELEASE-LEDGER-GUARD.IntentSummary: Extend validateTrainLedger from a three-line header comparison to a header plus item-membership comparison. Every userFacing, operational and notPresent item id must appear in the Markdown ledger as a whole id; omission raises the existing MT_RELEASE_LEDGER_DRIFT. Add a negative regression that keeps the header valid and omits an item, and record the invariant in M-046 and V-M-046. No JSON, workflow or release-material changes.

MustContain.Text: rejects Markdown ledger drift without choosing prose over JSON
validateTrainLedger - Rejects drift between the JSON authority and its human Markdown ledger header and item membership.
rejects a Markdown ledger that omits an admitted item
every admitted or excluded item id

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The spec records the owner's standing hygiene instruction, the observed drift and the four admission commits; the plan passes the grace change-plan schema and both files pass grace lint.

validateTrainLedger requires each admitted and excluded item id as a whole id (C-1 does not match C-10); omission raises MT_RELEASE_LEDGER_DRIFT with missingItems=<count>; the contract VERSION/CHANGE_SUMMARY and the MODULE_MAP line are updated; a negative test keeps the valid header and omits an item, plus a passing case names all three fixture ids.
M-046 Summary and V-M-046 carry the membership invariant; the live 2.9.x-next pair passes; the release suite and grace lint are green.
